curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How do bad weather, health problems, and war near filming locations threaten Apocalypse Now’s production?
curatedMovie.description: This documentary chronicles the chaotic production of Apocalypse Now, where bad weather, actors' failing health, and real combat near Philippine filming locations pushed Francis Ford Coppola to the brink of ruin.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Thoughtful yet emotionally charged, this medium-paced documentary provides an engaging, detailed descent into moviemaking madness.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: It offers an intimate, high-stakes chronicle of creative obsession, detailing the escalating costs and extreme crises that nearly destroyed a director's career.

facts.director: George Hickenlooper & Fax Bahr & Eleanor Coppola
facts.title: Hearts of Darkness: A Filmmaker's Apocalypse
